description: inference-expert-agents — stdlib-only Python CLIs (JSON in/out) for inference-time compute: triage, deliberate, verify, certify.
name: inference-expert-agents

tools.name: _common
tools.purpose: Shared clean-error contract: never traceback, emit {error} + exit 2 (internal)

tools.name: _compact
tools.purpose: Strip JSON whitespace for machine consumers (~15-25% fewer tokens)

tools.name: answer_certificate
tools.purpose: Machine-checkable answer certificates (assemble/validate)

tools.name: brevity
tools.purpose: Rule-based output condenser: drops boilerplate, protects content, reports saved%

tools.name: cache_kit
tools.purpose: Exact+semantic answer cache (TTL + LRU); state strictly opt-in via --db (0600)

tools.name: cascade
tools.purpose: Cheapest-first model cascade + speculative draft-verify pair

tools.name: citecheck
tools.purpose: Verify a citation against arXiv/OpenAlex before repeating it (id resolves AND attribution correct)

tools.name: compress
tools.purpose: Input-token compression + Chain-of-Draft output contract

tools.name: conformal
tools.purpose: Calibrated abstention thresholds, coverage-risk curve, escalation gate

tools.name: cove
tools.purpose: Chain-of-Verification: factored per-claim checks (plan/crosscheck/revise)

tools.name: debate
tools.purpose: Multiagent debate schedule + consensus stability

tools.name: deep_research
tools.purpose: Deep-research loop planner + source tiering

tools.name: deliberate
tools.purpose: Rung planner: adaptive budgets, early-exit/abort, budget forcing

tools.name: eval_regression
tools.purpose: Golden-set gates, baseline compare, runs ledger, annotation queue; state strictly opt-in via --db (0600)

tools.name: grounding_gate
tools.purpose: Per-sentence citation validation -> accept/regenerate/refuse (multi-citation)

tools.name: inference_scorecard
tools.purpose: Rubric scorer incl. FActScore-style atomic_claim_support

tools.name: jsonfix
tools.purpose: Staged near-JSON repair (fences/trim/commas/literals/brackets) with repair log

tools.name: judge_panel
tools.purpose: Judge ensembles (majority/minority-veto/weighted) + bias checklist

tools.name: ladder_trace
tools.purpose: Per-rung cost telemetry + failure taxonomy; state strictly opt-in via --db (0600)

tools.name: mcp_server
tools.purpose: Expose 5 core tools over MCP (stdio JSON-RPC 2.0) with F38 structural + approval gate

tools.name: memory_kit
tools.purpose: Reflections/rules/skills (stable ids) + deliberate forgetting; state strictly opt-in via --db (0600)

tools.name: portability
tools.purpose: Model-tier classification + adapted inference settings

tools.name: retrieval
tools.purpose: Local BM25 retrieval over sqlite FTS5 (build/query/stats); state strictly opt-in via --db (0600)

tools.name: sandbox_drill
tools.purpose: Planted-error recovery drills + transcript hygiene verdicts

tools.name: selfcheck
tools.purpose: SelfCheckGPT-style sampling check + cluster entropy

tools.name: selfimprove
tools.purpose: Bandit rule ranking, pruning, gated TextGrad-style amendments; state via --db (0600)

tools.name: speed
tools.purpose: tok/s measurement + serving-lever plans + parallel sampling

tools.name: theatre
tools.purpose: Detect verification theatre: flag any verification result whose check could not have failed

tools.name: tool_guards
tools.purpose: Tool-call validation, strict structured outputs, Assert/Suggest retries

tools.name: triage
tools.purpose: Classify query difficulty (trivial/standard/hard) + deliberation preset

references.note: load references on demand; SKILL.md + manifest.json are the only always-read files
